provenance: Official source: yes. This data is BetaNYC's, derived from it, not an official New York City Council record.

This server answers from a local SQLite index, with no network call. The index is built from a clone of jehiah/nyc_legislation (https://github.com/jehiah/nyc_legislation), an unofficial mirror that copies the Council's Legistar records through the Legistar API. Every local answer ends with a line naming when the index was built and the archive commit it was built from.

Changed by BetaNYC: Records are restructured into database tables with their values unchanged. aggregate_bills counts bills by a field, and co_sponsors counts the bills each pair of members sponsored together.

dataset.scopeNote: Caveat: The jehiah/nyc_legislation archive is not the Council's: it is an independent copy, and it can lag Legistar. How current shows when this server's index was built; the archive commit it was built from, which is how current the copy is, is named at the end of every local answer. Caveat: An empty local answer means 'not in this index', not 'does not exist'.

Curated by BetaNYC: lines and votes copied from the Board's certified 'Statement and Return Report for Certification' for the election that gave each member their seat, with a link to that document on each row. Never inferred from a caucus or from Wikidata. Shipped in data/council-party.json; nothing is looked up at run time.
